title: Comparison of Three Botulinum Neuromodulators for Management of Facial Synkinesis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effectiveness of three commercially available botulinum toxin neuromodulators in the treatment of facial synkinesis using patient reported outcome measures.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Facial synkinesis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous complication from botulinum toxin neuromodulator injection
* Inability to understand or complete the SAQ survey
* Inability to participate in follow-up
* Pregnancy
condition: Facial Paresis Associated With Facial Nerve Dysfunction
